package student

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	domainservice "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/service"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	practiceTaskTaskTypePracticeTaskMilestone = int16(10)
	taskExecutionModeBrowserPreview           = "BROWSER_PREVIEW"
	taskEvaluationModeAuto                    = "AUTO"
	taskUIModePreview                         = "PREVIEW"
	taskSubmissionModeSnapshot                = "SNAPSHOT"
	blockingReasonMilestonePrerequisites      = "MILESTONE_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET"
)

func (useCase StudentUseCase) GetRuntimeTask(ctx context.Context, taskID, studentID, answerID string) (*domain.RuntimeTaskSnapshot, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(answerID) != "" {
		binding, err := useCase.Students.GetTaskBindingByAnswerID(ctx, answerID)
		if err == nil {
			var snapshot domain.RuntimeTaskSnapshot
			if decodeErr := json.Unmarshal(binding.TaskSnapshotJSON, &snapshot); decodeErr != nil {
				return nil, decodeErr
			}
			return &snapshot, nil
		}
	}

	project, err := useCase.Students.GetStudentPracticeTaskByWorkspaceTaskID(ctx, taskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if studentID != "" && project.StudentID != studentID {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}

	if currentPart, err := useCase.loadActivePartRuntimeContextForProject(ctx, project, true); err == nil {
		bundle, bundleErr := useCase.buildPartBundleFromContext(currentPart, nil)
		if bundleErr != nil {
			return nil, bundleErr
		}
		return buildRuntimeTaskSnapshotFromPart(*currentPart, bundle.Access)
	} else if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
		return nil, err
	}

	current, err := useCase.loadCurrentMilestoneContext(ctx, project.StudentID, project.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	access, err := useCase.resolveCurrentMilestoneAccess(ctx, current)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return buildRuntimeTaskSnapshot(*current, *access)
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) GetRuntimeLesson(ctx context.Context, lessonID, studentID string) (*domain.RuntimeLesson, error) {
	project, err := useCase.Students.GetStudentPracticeTaskByWorkspaceLessonID(ctx, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if studentID != "" && project.StudentID != studentID {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}

	if currentPart, err := useCase.loadActivePartRuntimeContextForProject(ctx, project, false); err == nil {
		description := currentPart.runtimeContext.PracticeTask.Theme
		if currentPart.part.Description != nil && strings.TrimSpace(*currentPart.part.Description) != "" {
			description = *currentPart.part.Description
		}
		return &domain.RuntimeLesson{
			ID:          project.WorkspaceLessonID,
			CourseID:    project.PracticeTaskID,
			Title:       currentPart.part.Title,
			Description: description,
			Order:       1,
			Status:      domain.TaskStatusActive,
		}, nil
	} else if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
		return nil, err
	}

	current, err := useCase.loadCurrentMilestoneContext(ctx, project.StudentID, project.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	title := current.project.Title
	if current.currentPracticeTaskMilestone != nil && strings.TrimSpace(current.currentPracticeTaskMilestone.Title) != "" {
		title = current.currentPracticeTaskMilestone.Title
	}
	description := current.project.Theme
	if current.currentPracticeTaskMilestone != nil && current.currentPracticeTaskMilestone.Description != nil && strings.TrimSpace(*current.currentPracticeTaskMilestone.Description) != "" {
		description = *current.currentPracticeTaskMilestone.Description
	}

	return &domain.RuntimeLesson{
		ID:          project.WorkspaceLessonID,
		CourseID:    project.PracticeTaskID,
		Title:       title,
		Description: description,
		Order:       1,
		Status:      domain.TaskStatusActive,
	}, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) GetRuntimeTaskAccess(ctx context.Context, taskID, studentID string) (*domain.MilestoneAccess, error) {
	project, err := useCase.Students.GetStudentPracticeTaskByWorkspaceTaskID(ctx, taskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if studentID != "" && project.StudentID != studentID {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if currentPart, err := useCase.loadActivePartRuntimeContextForProject(ctx, project, false); err == nil {
		bundle, bundleErr := useCase.buildPartBundleFromContext(currentPart, nil)
		if bundleErr != nil {
			return nil, bundleErr
		}
		return &bundle.Access, nil
	} else if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
		return nil, err
	}
	current, err := useCase.loadCurrentMilestoneContext(ctx, project.StudentID, project.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return useCase.resolveCurrentMilestoneAccess(ctx, current)
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) BindRuntimeAnswer(ctx context.Context, studentID, taskID, answerID string, sandbox *domain.SandboxSession) (*domain.RuntimeTaskSnapshot, error) {
	project, err := useCase.Students.GetStudentPracticeTaskByWorkspaceTaskID(ctx, taskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if project.StudentID != studentID {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}

	if currentPart, err := useCase.loadActivePartRuntimeContextForProject(ctx, project, true); err == nil {
		bundle, bundleErr := useCase.buildPartBundleFromContext(currentPart, nil)
		if bundleErr != nil {
			return nil, bundleErr
		}
		if bundle.Access.Locked {
			return nil, firstLockedPartError(bundle)
		}
		if sandbox != nil && useCase.Sandbox != nil {
			if err := useCase.seedMissingPartStarterFiles(ctx, currentPart, sandbox); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}

		snapshot, err := buildRuntimeTaskSnapshotFromPart(*currentPart, bundle.Access)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		snapshotJSON, err := json.Marshal(snapshot)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		now := time.Now().UTC()
		representative := currentPartRepresentativeMilestone(currentPart)
		if representative == nil {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		if representative.TaskAnswerID == nil || *representative.TaskAnswerID != answerID {
			milestoneCopy := *representative
			milestoneCopy.TaskAnswerID = &answerID
			milestoneCopy.UpdatedAt = now
			milestoneCopy.Status = domain.StudentMilestoneStatusInProgress
			if sandbox != nil {
				milestoneCopy.SandboxID = &sandbox.SandboxID
			}
			if err := useCase.Students.UpdateStudentPracticeTaskMilestone(ctx, milestoneCopy); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}

		binding := domain.StudentPracticeTaskTaskBinding{
			ID:                             uuid.NewString(),
			StudentPracticeTaskID:          currentPart.studentPracticeTask.ID,
			StudentPracticeTaskMilestoneID: representative.ID,
			TaskAnswerID:                   answerID,
			TaskID:                         currentPart.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceTaskID,
			LessonID:                       currentPart.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceLessonID,
			TaskSnapshotJSON:               snapshotJSON,
			CreatedAt:                      now,
			UpdatedAt:                      now,
		}
		if err := useCase.Students.SaveTaskBinding(ctx, binding); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		projectCopy := *currentPart.studentPracticeTask
		projectCopy.CurrentTaskAnswerID = &answerID
		projectCopy.UpdatedAt = now
		if sandbox != nil {
			projectCopy.ActiveSandboxID = &sandbox.SandboxID
			projectCopy.PreviewURL = nullableStringPointer(sandbox.PreviewURL)
		}
		if err := useCase.Students.UpdateStudentPracticeTask(ctx, projectCopy); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return snapshot, nil
	} else if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
		return nil, err
	}

	current, err := useCase.loadCurrentMilestoneContext(ctx, studentID, project.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	access, err := useCase.resolveCurrentMilestoneAccess(ctx, current)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if access.Locked {
		return nil, &domain.MilestoneLockedError{
			StudentPracticeTaskID:          current.studentPracticeTask.ID,
			StudentPracticeTaskMilestoneID: current.currentStudentMilestone.ID,
			BlockingReason:                 access.BlockingReason,
			Prerequisites:                  access.Prerequisites,
		}
	}

	if sandbox != nil && useCase.Sandbox != nil {
		if err := useCase.seedMissingStarterFiles(ctx, current, sandbox); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	snapshot, err := buildRuntimeTaskSnapshot(*current, *access)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	snapshotJSON, err := json.Marshal(snapshot)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	if current.currentStudentMilestone.TaskAnswerID == nil || *current.currentStudentMilestone.TaskAnswerID != answerID {
		currentMilestone := *current.currentStudentMilestone
		currentMilestone.TaskAnswerID = &answerID
		currentMilestone.UpdatedAt = now
		currentMilestone.Status = domain.StudentMilestoneStatusInProgress
		if sandbox != nil {
			currentMilestone.SandboxID = &sandbox.SandboxID
		}
		current.currentStudentMilestone = &currentMilestone
		if err := useCase.Students.UpdateStudentPracticeTaskMilestone(ctx, currentMilestone); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	binding := domain.StudentPracticeTaskTaskBinding{
		ID:                             uuid.NewString(),
		StudentPracticeTaskID:          current.studentPracticeTask.ID,
		StudentPracticeTaskMilestoneID: current.currentStudentMilestone.ID,
		TaskAnswerID:                   answerID,
		TaskID:                         current.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceTaskID,
		LessonID:                       current.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceLessonID,
		TaskSnapshotJSON:               snapshotJSON,
		CreatedAt:                      now,
		UpdatedAt:                      now,
	}
	if err := useCase.Students.SaveTaskBinding(ctx, binding); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	projectCopy := *current.studentPracticeTask
	projectCopy.CurrentTaskAnswerID = &answerID
	projectCopy.UpdatedAt = now
	if sandbox != nil {
		projectCopy.ActiveSandboxID = &sandbox.SandboxID
		projectCopy.PreviewURL = nullableStringPointer(sandbox.PreviewURL)
	}
	if err := useCase.Students.UpdateStudentPracticeTask(ctx, projectCopy); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return snapshot, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) FinalizeRuntimeAnswer(ctx context.Context, input domain.RuntimeFinalizeInput) error {
	binding, err := useCase.Students.GetTaskBindingByAnswerID(ctx, input.AnswerID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var snapshot domain.RuntimeTaskSnapshot
	if len(bytes.TrimSpace(binding.TaskSnapshotJSON)) > 0 {
		if err := json.Unmarshal(binding.TaskSnapshotJSON, &snapshot); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(snapshot.TaskKind), practiceTaskTaskKindPart) {
			return useCase.finalizeRuntimePartAnswer(ctx, binding, snapshot, input)
		}
	}

	project, err := useCase.Students.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, binding.StudentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	milestones, err := useCase.Students.ListStudentPracticeTaskMilestones(ctx, binding.StudentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	var currentMilestone *domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone
	for index := range milestones {
		if milestones[index].ID == binding.StudentPracticeTaskMilestoneID {
			item := milestones[index]
			currentMilestone = &item
			break
		}
	}
	if currentMilestone == nil {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	alreadyFinalizedForAnswer := currentMilestone.TaskAnswerID != nil &&
		*currentMilestone.TaskAnswerID == input.AnswerID &&
		isFinalizedMilestoneStatus(currentMilestone.Status) &&
		len(bytes.TrimSpace(currentMilestone.BestResultJSON)) > 0

	currentMilestone.TaskAnswerID = &input.AnswerID
	currentMilestone.UpdatedAt = now
	if input.SandboxID != nil {
		currentMilestone.SandboxID = input.SandboxID
	}
	if !alreadyFinalizedForAnswer {
		currentMilestone.AttemptsCount++
	}
	if len(input.RawResult) > 0 {
		// MVP keeps the latest finalized validation payload as milestone best_result_json.
		// History itself lives in student answer rows plus student_practice_task_task_binding entries.
		currentMilestone.BestResultJSON = input.RawResult
	}
	if input.Passed {
		currentMilestone.Status = domain.StudentMilestoneStatusPassed
		currentMilestone.PassedAt = &now
	} else {
		currentMilestone.Status = domain.StudentMilestoneStatusFailed
		currentMilestone.PassedAt = nil
	}
	if err := useCase.Students.UpdateStudentPracticeTaskMilestone(ctx, *currentMilestone); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	project.UpdatedAt = now
	project.CurrentTaskAnswerID = &input.AnswerID
	if input.SandboxID != nil {
		project.ActiveSandboxID = input.SandboxID
	}
	if input.PreviewURL != nil {
		project.PreviewURL = input.PreviewURL
	}
	if err := useCase.Students.UpdateStudentPracticeTask(ctx, *project); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if !alreadyFinalizedForAnswer && input.FileStorageID != nil && *input.FileStorageID != "" {
		metaJSON, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
			"task_answer_id":                     input.AnswerID,
			"student_practice_task_milestone_id": currentMilestone.ID,
			"status":                             input.Status,
		})
		artifact := domain.StudentPracticeTaskArtifact{
			ID:                    uuid.NewString(),
			StudentPracticeTaskID: project.ID,
			ArtifactType:          "task_answer_submission",
			StorageFileID:         *input.FileStorageID,
			PreviewURL:            input.PreviewURL,
			MetaJSON:              metaJSON,
			CreatedAt:             now,
		}
		if err := useCase.Students.CreateArtifact(ctx, artifact); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	if input.Passed {
		if err := useCase.advanceProjectAfterRuntimePass(ctx, project, currentMilestone.ID, now); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) resolveCurrentMilestoneAccess(ctx context.Context, current *currentMilestoneContext) (*domain.MilestoneAccess, error) {
	runtimeContext, err := useCase.getStudentPracticeTaskRuntimeContext(ctx, current.studentPracticeTask)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var (
		requiredSkillTags  []string
		matchedLessonIDs   []string
		unmatchedSkillTags []string
	)
	skillTagsByCode := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, item := range runtimeContext.MilestoneSkillTags {
		if item.MilestoneKindCode != current.currentPracticeTaskMilestone.MilestoneKindCode {
			continue
		}
		requiredSkillTags = append(requiredSkillTags, item.SkillTagCode)
		skillTagsByCode[item.SkillTagCode] = struct{}{}
	}

	matchedLessonsSet := map[string]struct{}{}
	skillMatched := map[string]bool{}
	for _, skillTag := range requiredSkillTags {
		for _, lessonTag := range runtimeContext.LessonSkillTags {
			if lessonTag.SkillTagCode != skillTag {
				continue
			}
			skillMatched[skillTag] = true
			matchedLessonsSet[lessonTag.LessonID] = struct{}{}
		}
	}

	for _, skillTag := range requiredSkillTags {
		if !skillMatched[skillTag] {
			unmatchedSkillTags = append(unmatchedSkillTags, skillTag)
		}
	}

	matchedLessonIDs = sortedStringKeys(matchedLessonsSet)
	completedLessonsSet := map[string]struct{}{}
	if useCase.Completion != nil && len(matchedLessonIDs) > 0 {
		completedLessonsSet, err = useCase.Completion.GetCompletedLessonIDs(ctx, current.studentPracticeTask.StudentID, matchedLessonIDs)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	completedLessonIDs := sortedStringKeys(completedLessonsSet)
	unmetLessonIDs := diffStrings(matchedLessonIDs, completedLessonIDs)

	status := domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusAvailable
	switch current.currentStudentMilestone.Status {
	case domain.StudentMilestoneStatusPassed:
		status = domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusPassed
	case domain.StudentMilestoneStatusSkipped:
		status = domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusSkipped
	case domain.StudentMilestoneStatusInProgress:
		status = domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusInProgress
	case domain.StudentMilestoneStatusFailed:
		status = domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusFailed
	}

	locked := len(unmetLessonIDs) > 0 || len(unmatchedSkillTags) > 0
	blockingReason := ""
	if locked {
		status = domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusLocked
		blockingReason = blockingReasonMilestonePrerequisites
	}

	if current.currentStudentMilestone.TaskAnswerID != nil && status == domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusAvailable {
		status = domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusInProgress
	}

	access := &domain.MilestoneAccess{
		Status:              status,
		Locked:              locked,
		BlockingReason:      blockingReason,
		CurrentTaskID:       current.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceTaskID,
		CurrentLessonID:     current.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceLessonID,
		CurrentTaskAnswerID: current.studentPracticeTask.CurrentTaskAnswerID,
		CurrentSandboxID:    current.studentPracticeTask.ActiveSandboxID,
		PreviewURL:          current.studentPracticeTask.PreviewURL,
		Prerequisites: domain.MilestonePrerequisites{
			RequiredSkillTags:  dedupeStrings(requiredSkillTags),
			MatchedLessonIDs:   matchedLessonIDs,
			CompletedLessonIDs: completedLessonIDs,
			UnmetLessonIDs:     unmetLessonIDs,
			UnmatchedSkillTags: dedupeStrings(unmatchedSkillTags),
		},
	}

	if runtimeContext.PracticeTask.ID != "" && access.CurrentLessonID == "" {
		access.CurrentLessonID = current.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceLessonID
	}
	return access, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) seedMissingStarterFiles(ctx context.Context, current *currentMilestoneContext, sandbox *domain.SandboxSession) error {
	if useCase.Sandbox == nil || sandbox == nil {
		return nil
	}
	files, err := useCase.Sandbox.GetSnapshot(ctx, sandbox.SandboxID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	existing := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, file := range files {
		existing[file.Path] = struct{}{}
	}
	for _, file := range current.preview.Starter.Files {
		if _, ok := existing[file.Path]; ok {
			continue
		}
		if err := useCase.Sandbox.CreateFile(ctx, sandbox.SandboxID, current.studentPracticeTask.StudentID, file.Path, file.Content); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func buildRuntimeTaskSnapshot(current currentMilestoneContext, access domain.MilestoneAccess) (*domain.RuntimeTaskSnapshot, error) {
	runtimePlan, err := buildMilestoneRuntimePlan(current)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	learningTargets, err := domain.NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(current.currentPracticeTaskMilestone.LearningTargets)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	description := strings.TrimSpace(derefString(current.currentPracticeTaskMilestone.Description))
	if acceptance := extractAcceptanceChecklist(current.currentPracticeTaskMilestone.AcceptanceCriteriaJSON); len(acceptance) > 0 {
		acceptanceText := strings.Join(acceptance, "\n- ")
		if description != "" {
			description += "\n\nAcceptance criteria:\n- " + acceptanceText
		} else {
			description = "Acceptance criteria:\n- " + acceptanceText
		}
	}

	return &domain.RuntimeTaskSnapshot{
		ID:                     current.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceTaskID,
		LessonID:               current.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceLessonID,
		CourseID:               current.project.ID,
		Title:                  current.currentPracticeTaskMilestone.Title,
		Description:            description,
		LearningTargets:        learningTargets,
		Status:                 domain.TaskStatusActive,
		Type:                   practiceTaskTaskTypePracticeTaskMilestone,
		TaskKind:               "practice_task_milestone",
		CodeStructureTypeCode:  runtimePlan.CodeStructureTypeCode,
		CodeStructure:          runtimePlan.ContractJSON,
		ComposeConfig:          runtimePlan.ComposeConfig,
		ExecutionMode:          taskExecutionModeBrowserPreview,
		EvaluationMode:         taskEvaluationModeAuto,
		UIMode:                 taskUIModePreview,
		SubmissionMode:         taskSubmissionModeSnapshot,
		RequiresSandbox:        true,
		ExposesPreview:         true,
		ExposesTerminal:        false,
		SupportsLiveValidation: true,
		AllowedErrorsCount:     0,
		Access:                 access,
	}, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) advanceProjectAfterRuntimePass(ctx context.Context, project *domain.StudentPracticeTask, passedStudentMilestoneID string, now time.Time) error {
	milestones, err := useCase.Students.ListStudentPracticeTaskMilestones(ctx, project.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if allMilestonesCompleted(milestones) {
		runtimeContext, err := useCase.getStudentPracticeTaskRuntimeContext(ctx, project)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		variant, err := selectedRuntimeVariant(runtimeContext, project.PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, reviewConfigured, err := parsePracticeTaskReviewPolicy(variant.ReviewPolicyJSON)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if reviewConfigured {
			project.Status = domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusReadyForReview
			project.CompletedAt = nil
		} else {
			project.Status = domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusCompleted
			project.CompletedAt = &now
		}
		project.UpdatedAt = now
		return useCase.Students.UpdateStudentPracticeTask(ctx, *project)
	}
	return nil
}

func sortedStringKeys(values map[string]struct{}) []string {
	result := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for value := range values {
		result = append(result, value)
	}
	return sortStrings(result)
}

func sortStrings(values []string) []string {
	if len(values) == 0 {
		return []string{}
	}
	result := append([]string(nil), values...)
	for left := 0; left < len(result); left++ {
		for right := left + 1; right < len(result); right++ {
			if result[right] < result[left] {
				result[left], result[right] = result[right], result[left]
			}
		}
	}
	return result
}

func diffStrings(source []string, completed []string) []string {
	completedSet := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, item := range completed {
		completedSet[item] = struct{}{}
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(source))
	for _, item := range source {
		if _, ok := completedSet[item]; ok {
			continue
		}
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	return result
}

func isFinalizedMilestoneStatus(status int16) bool {
	return status == domain.StudentMilestoneStatusPassed ||
		status == domain.StudentMilestoneStatusFailed ||
		status == domain.StudentMilestoneStatusSkipped
}

func dedupeStrings(values []string) []string {
	set := map[string]struct{}{}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for _, item := range values {
		if _, ok := set[item]; ok {
			continue
		}
		set[item] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	return sortStrings(result)
}

func extractAcceptanceChecklist(payload json.RawMessage) []string {
	if len(payload) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	var parsed struct {
		Checklist []string `json:"checklist"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &parsed); err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	return parsed.Checklist
}

func derefString(value *string) string {
	if value == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return *value
}

func nullableStringPointer(value string) *string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(value)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return nil
	}
	return &trimmed
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) resolveRoadmapStatuses(
	ctx context.Context,
	project *domain.StudentPracticeTask,
	practiceTaskMilestones []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone,
	studentMilestones []domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone,
	milestoneSkillTags []domain.MilestoneKindSkillTag,
	lessonSkillTags []domain.LessonSkillTag,
) (map[string]string, string, error) {
	studentMilestonesByPracticeTaskRuntimeMilestoneID := map[string]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone{}
	for _, item := range studentMilestones {
		studentMilestonesByPracticeTaskRuntimeMilestoneID[item.PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID] = item
	}

	runtimeContext := &domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext{
		PracticeTaskMilestones: practiceTaskMilestones,
		MilestoneSkillTags:     milestoneSkillTags,
		LessonSkillTags:        lessonSkillTags,
	}
	lessonIDs := runtimeContextLessonIDs(runtimeContext)
	completedLessonsSet := map[string]struct{}{}
	var err error
	if useCase.Completion != nil && len(lessonIDs) > 0 {
		completedLessonsSet, err = useCase.Completion.GetCompletedLessonIDs(ctx, project.StudentID, lessonIDs)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, "", err
		}
	}

	result := map[string]string{}
	currentMilestoneID := ""
	for _, milestone := range domainservice.SortMilestonesForStudent(practiceTaskMilestones) {
		studentMilestone, ok := studentMilestonesByPracticeTaskRuntimeMilestoneID[milestone.ID]
		if !ok {
			continue
		}

		status := domain.RoadmapStatusLabel(studentMilestone.Status)
		if studentMilestone.Status == domain.StudentMilestoneStatusNotStarted {
			prerequisites := resolvePartMilestonePrerequisites(runtimeContext, milestone, completedLessonsSet)
			if len(prerequisites.UnmetLessonIDs) > 0 || len(prerequisites.UnmatchedSkillTags) > 0 {
				status = domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusLocked
			} else if parentID := parentPartMilestoneID(milestone); parentID != "" && !roadmapMilestoneCompleted(studentMilestonesByPracticeTaskRuntimeMilestoneID[parentID]) {
				status = domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusLocked
			} else if previousID := previousRouteMilestoneID(practiceTaskMilestones, milestone); previousID != "" && !roadmapMilestoneCompleted(studentMilestonesByPracticeTaskRuntimeMilestoneID[previousID]) {
				status = domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusLocked
			} else {
				status = domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusAvailable
			}
		}
		result[milestone.ID] = status
		if currentMilestoneID == "" && status != domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusPassed && status != domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusSkipped {
			currentMilestoneID = milestone.ID
		}
	}
	return result, currentMilestoneID, nil
}

func roadmapMilestoneCompleted(item domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone) bool {
	return item.ID != "" && isMilestoneCompleted(item.Status)
}
